# tree-sitter-jass

A Tree-sitter grammar for the JASS scripting language used by Warcraft III.

## Features

* Full JASS grammar
* Incremental parsing through Tree-sitter
* Generated C parser
* Node.js bindings
* Java bindings
* Query files for syntax-aware tooling
* Suitable for editors, language servers, linters, and static analysis

## Project Structure

```text
grammar.js
grammar-defs.js
src/
bindings/c/
bindings/node/
bindings/java/
```

## Scope

This repository focuses on parsing and syntax tree generation.

Semantic validation is intentionally outside the scope of the grammar.

Examples of checks that are not performed:

* Undefined symbols
* Invalid function calls
* Type mismatches
* Incorrect native usage
* Warcraft III API compatibility checks

A source file may therefore parse successfully and still fail compilation.

## Semantic Analysis

For semantic validation and advanced static analysis, see Prism:

https://github.com/Slayer95/prism

Prism consumes the trees generated by this grammar and performs:

* Symbol resolution
* Type checking
* Semantic diagnostics
* Linting
* Additional language tooling

## Node.js

```bash
npm install github:Slayer95/tree-sitter-jass#main
```

## Java

Java bindings are included in this repository for consumers embedding the parser into JVM-based tooling.

Refer to the files under:

```text
bindings/java/
```

## Development

Generate the parser:

```bash
tree-sitter generate
```
